name: IU Open Equal to High Low

template.name: IU Open Equal to High Low
template.notes: The open-equals-low geometry is applied to any bar with a 0.1% equality tolerance because the DSL has no session/time fields to isolate the first candle of the day, and the long side (open at the low, close up) is traded. The prior-candle low becomes the structural exit; the RiskReward 2 target and stop are price distances, not percents.
